commands: nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' develop path:./nix --command bash -c 'cmake --preset debug && cmake --build --preset debug'

nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' develop path:./nix --command python3 -m tools.analysis.return_case export --completed-through 24 --case .local/execution/return-case-all-factories-003.json --expected .local/execution/return-expected-all-factories-003.json

nix --extra-experimental-features 'nix-command flakes' develop path:./nix --command python3 -m tools.analysis.execution run --case .local/execution/return-case-all-factories-003.json --expected .local/execution/return-expected-all-factories-003.json --report .local/execution/return-run-all-factories-003.json

validation.expected: Exact separately captured restore and 25 factory state projections and upload requests. Runner must reach its selected modeled boundary; this status is a structural assertion, not an original-game oracle for return readiness.
validation.actual: Debug and ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer reports match 26 checkpoints and upload requests, with completed_boundary and 538 operations. Actor 19 intermediate comparison matches after sprite 94 at original sprite PC 8012a11e. Four focused sanitizer CTests and all 20 CTests in each debug, sanitizer and release preset pass; Python exporter/comparator tests pass (21 run, one skipped). Independent review found no mismatch in the reached A3/BC/94 and prior-sprite ownership branches, and flagged the final-state comparison limit now recorded here.
validation.tolerance: Exact only for listed checkpoint and upload projections. Captured original heap results are external inputs; part bytes use the qualified unchanged-write source invariant where applicable. No final whole-field, full return route, timing or readiness equivalence is claimed.

limitations: This establishes one observed factory route, not a complete sprite subsystem, return lifecycle or Phase 1 exit.
The completed-through comparison has no independent final-state oracle after factory 24; its checkpoints can match while an unprojected field state differs.
Initialization, original heap/shadow services, later checkpoint pass, party reassignment alternatives, cleanup, full field update, transitions, menu/persistence and required media remain open.
